hardRules.name: Sanctions match
hardRules.when: screen_sanctions returns a match score of 0.85 or more for the merchant or its owner
hardRules.then: escalate to financial_crime; tell the merchant only that the case is under review (no tipping-off)

hardRules.name: Lost or stolen card
hardRules.then: escalate to fraud; give the merchant the standard retained-card procedure only

hardRules.name: High value
hardRules.when: transaction amount is above GBP 5,000 (or its equivalent)
hardRules.then: escalate to approvals for a person to sign off, even if the cause is simple

hardRules.name: New merchant with a spike
hardRules.when: merchant onboarded fewer than 30 days ago AND recent volume is more than 3x its expected volume
hardRules.then: escalate to merchant_risk for fraud and KYB review

hardRules.name: Regulatory complaint
hardRules.when: the merchant mentions a regulator, ombudsman, legal action or a formal complaint

hardRules.name: Fail safe
hardRules.when: a required look-up fails after one retry

dataProtection.card_data_visible_to_agent: token and last four digits only
never_disclose_to_merchant: the reason for any financial-crime or fraud escalation

cases.title: EUR card, terminal set to GBP
cases.message: Irish customers can't pay since the terminal update.

result.decline_reason: currency not supported by terminal configuration

proposal.reason: Terminal configured for GBP only; transaction declined due to EUR currency not being supported. Merchant should reconfigure terminal settings to match their market.
proposal.message: Your terminal has been configured to accept GBP only, which is why transactions in EUR are being declined. Please review your terminal settings and ensure it's configured for the correct currency or currencies for your market. Contact your terminal provider if you need assistance with this configuration.

outcome.message: Your terminal has been configured to accept GBP only, which is why transactions in EUR are being declined. Please review your terminal settings and ensure it's configured for the correct currency or currencies for your market. Contact your terminal provider if you need assistance with this configuration.
